summary: Summit Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce positive topline results from a Phase III study (HARMONi-GI1) conducted by its partner Akeso in China. The study evaluated ivonescimab plus chemotherapy versus durvalumab plus chemotherapy in first-line advanced biliary tract cancer, meeting primary overall survival and key secondary endpoints. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of clinical trial data, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved.
